beats.label: S1 · Foggy dies, Matt retires
beats.text: Dex ambushes Josie's Bar and kills Foggy. Matt, as Daredevil, nearly hurls him from a rooftop; Cherry sees him unmasked. Matt retires from vigilantism.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Inciting loss that drives everything Matt does, and Cherry's knowledge seeds the eventual resistance.

beats.label: S1 · Fisk becomes mayor
beats.text: A year later, Fisk wins the mayoralty on anti-vigilante policing. He and Matt agree to an uneasy truce. Matt starts dating Heather Glenn, also Fisk's therapist.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the political board and the compromised triangle at the season's centre.

beats.label: S1 · Ayala case, Punisher symbol
beats.text: Matt defends vigilante Hector Ayala by outing his identity in court. Ayala is acquitted, then executed by an AVTF cop wearing the Punisher's symbol.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces corrupt Punisher-marked police and shows Matt's legal-only stance failing lethally.

beats.label: S1 · Vanessa's shadow rule
beats.text: While Fisk plays statesman, Vanessa quietly runs the gangs behind his back. Fisk secretly imprisons her lover Adam, then later has Vanessa kill him herself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up that Vanessa is the true criminal power in this era and primes her reveal at the ball.

beats.label: S1 · Muse, Daredevil returns
beats.text: Serial killer Muse's attacks push Fisk to form the AVTF, an anti-vigilante police unit. When Muse abducts Angela, Matt finally suits back up as Daredevil.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Breaks Matt's year-long retirement and establishes AVTF as Fisk's paramilitary arm.

beats.label: S1 · The ball, the bullet
beats.text: Matt learns Vanessa — not Fisk — hired Dex to kill Foggy. Dex escapes prison and fires on Fisk at his ball; Matt dives into the bullet's path.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reassigns blame for Foggy's murder and publicly binds Matt to Fisk in an unresolved way.

beats.label: S1 · Martial law
beats.text: Fisk kills police commissioner Gallo, blacks out the city, and declares martial law. Matt recruits Cherry, Kim, and honest cops to resist as Daredevil returns for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Escalates the conflict into open authoritarianism versus armed resistance, the frame S2 opens inside.

cliffhanger.text: Fisk has blacked out New York, declared martial law, and imprisoned dissidents — including the Punisher — at Red Hook. Matt is publicly Daredevil again, quietly building a resistance of honest cops.
questions: Can Matt's fledgling resistance break Fisk's grip on the city?
What will Vanessa do now that Matt knows she ordered Foggy's death?
How does Fisk plan to use Red Hook as a captive city-state?

characters.name: Matt Murdock
characters.line: Blind lawyer and Daredevil. Grieving Foggy, dating his therapist Heather, and now leading a resistance against Fisk's martial law.

characters.name: Wilson Fisk
characters.line: Newly elected mayor turned dictator. Has declared martial law after Dex's assassination attempt and knows Matt is Daredevil.

characters.name: Vanessa Fisk
characters.line: Fisk's wife; secretly ran the city's gangs behind his back and hired Dex to kill Foggy in retaliation for the vigilante attack on Fisk.

characters.name: Karen Page
characters.line: Matt's old partner and love; moved to San Francisco after Foggy's death but returned to protect Matt once Dex escaped prison.

characters.name: Heather Glenn
characters.line: Matt's therapist girlfriend, also Fisk and Vanessa's counselor. Traumatised after killing Muse and just accepted Fisk's Mental Health Commissioner post.

characters.name: Benjamin "Dex" Poindexter
characters.line: The killer Vanessa hired to murder Foggy. Escaped prison and shot Fisk at the ball; now at large and dangerous to both sides.

characters.name: Cherry
characters.line: Retired NYPD and Matt's investigator. One of the few who knows he is Daredevil, now organising honest cops into the resistance.

characters.name: Kirsten McDuffie
characters.line: Former district attorney; Matt's partner at the successor firm to Nelson & Murdock.

characters.name: BB Urich
characters.line: Young journalist secretly building a case against Fisk. Niece of the reporter Ben Urich, whom Fisk once had killed.

beats.label: S2 · Matt outed, Dex covers
beats.text: Matt is Daredevil again, chasing Fisk's arms shipments through Red Hook. AVTF officers unmask him during a raid; Dex kills them before they can talk.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Dex as an unpredictable third party protecting Matt's identity for his own reasons.

beats.label: S2 · CIA enters the game
beats.text: Fisk brands Matt a hero to lure him out, while secretly working with CIA agent Mr. Charles to move weapons through his port. Matt and Karen go underground at Josie's.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Mr. Charles and raises the stakes beyond a purely city-scale fight.

beats.label: S2 · Red Hook cracked open
beats.text: Kirsten loses vigilante Jack Duquesne's trial despite Fisk having no evidence. Matt breaks into Red Hook using clues from her visit and frees Fisk's prisoners.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Exposes the free-port prison and pulls the underground resistance into full-on offense.

beats.label: S2 · Vanessa dies
beats.text: Dex ambushes Fisk at a boxing match. Vanessa is struck by a glass shard, briefly wakes confused after surgery, then dies of her injuries.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's hinge: strips Fisk of the only person who kept his cruelty in check.

beats.label: S2 · Fisk unrestrained, Karen arrested
beats.text: Fisk, unmoored by grief, seizes Mr. Charles's weapons for AVTF and murders Vanessa's surgeon. Karen joins protests against him; an AVTF killing sparks chaos and she is arrested.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Karen's arrest is the trigger that pulls Matt out of hiding for the season's climactic trial.

beats.label: S2 · Matt unmasks in court
beats.text: Matt unmasks himself as Daredevil in court to corroborate testimony that Fisk sank the Northern Star and killed its crew. The case against Karen is dismissed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's climax; publicly ends Matt's dual life and detonates Fisk's political cover.

beats.label: S2 · Fisk exiled, Matt jailed
beats.text: Fisk massacres protesters, then accepts exile to avoid charges. The AVTF is disbanded. Heather dons Muse's mask, Dex now serves Mr. Charles, and Matt is arrested for his crimes as Daredevil.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves Fisk's mayoralty but leaves Heather-as-Muse, Dex-under-CIA, and Matt in prison as three live threads.

cliffhanger.text: Fisk is deposed and exiled after Matt unmasks in court, but Matt is then arrested for his own vigilante crimes. Heather has quietly put on Muse's mask, and Dex is now a CIA asset.
questions: How will Matt survive prison as a blind man surrounded by criminals he put away?
What is Heather doing behind the Muse mask?
Will Fisk stay in exile, or return to reclaim what he lost?

characters.name: Matt Murdock
characters.line: Daredevil publicly after unmasking himself in court to save Karen. Now imprisoned for his vigilante crimes despite winning the case.

characters.name: Wilson Fisk
characters.line: Deposed and exiled after his tyranny collapsed. His wife Vanessa is dead, killed by shrapnel from Dex's assassination attempt.

characters.name: Karen Page
characters.line: Matt's partner again in life and law; watched him go from courtroom victor to convicted vigilante within hours.

characters.name: Heather Glenn
characters.line: Broken by Muse's earlier assault. Doing work for Fisk as a therapist, then put on Muse's mask herself.

characters.name: Benjamin "Dex" Poindexter
characters.line: Killed AVTF officers to protect Matt's cover, saved the governor from assassination, and now serves the CIA under Mr. Charles.

characters.name: Mr. Charles
characters.line: Ruthless CIA operative who forced Fisk to funnel weapons through Red Hook and moved to have Jessica Jones killed. Recruited Dex after Fisk's fall.

characters.name: Kirsten McDuffie
characters.line: Matt's law partner. Defended vigilante Jack Duquesne, helped clear Karen, and provided the intel Matt used to break into Red Hook.

characters.name: BB Urich
characters.line: Journalist who covertly undermined Fisk with a "Mayor Kingpin" smear campaign and rallied the courthouse protests. Now working for the New York Bulletin.
